name: The context aperture
reader_question: What must remain attached when knowledge enters a task?
visual_idea: Candidate context narrows through an explicit review aperture into one task packet; unselected context leaves a visible gap.
why_geometry_helps: Candidate context narrows through an explicit review aperture into one task packet; unselected context leaves a visible gap.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: A funnel could imply quantitative filtering or automatic approval; widths encode no amount, controls select candidate material only.
